sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धाः सर्वे सुरगणास्तदा ।रावणं विमुखीकृत्य शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ।। ७.२९.३२ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare kruddhāḥ sarve suragaṇāstadā ।rāvaṇaṁ vimukhīkṛtya śaravarṣairavākiran ।। 7.29.32 ॥

translations.english: At that moment, all the enraged hosts of gods, having defeated Ravana, showered him with torrents of arrows.
